Durable finishes are formulated to resist UV-related fading and chalking. Robust weather-stripping and quality hardware support long-term, everyday performance. Infinity = Low Maintenance Spend time enjoying your home - not maintaining your windows. Virtually maintenance-free frames and finishes - no scraping or repainting required. Easy-clean features (e.g., tilt-in sashes on double-hung; innovative casement hardware) simplify upkeep. Simple care: occasional cleaning with mild soap and water keeps windows looking their best. Professional installation from RGS supports long-term performance with correct flashing and sealing. Bottom line: Infinity windows are built for everyday life with minimal upkeep. Infinity = Energy-Smart Living Comfort you can feel - efficiency you can measure. Energy-efficient glass packages help reduce heating and cooling loads. Long service life means fewer replacements over time - less waste and a smaller footprint. Tight seals and stable frames support consistent indoor temperatures across seasons. Bigger glass areas enhance daylighting, which can reduce reliance on electric lighting during the day. Bottom line: Infinity windows help create an efficient, comfortable home - year after year. Triple Pane Windows For Utah Homeowners| RGS Exteriors About Us Contact Galleries Financing Resources Phone (801) 997-6616 Get Pre-Approved Siding Rain Gutters Windows Decks Other Services Why Us Utah’s Premier Source For Triple-Pane Replacement Windows Expertly Installed For The Price Of Double-Pane Your windows are the key to an energy-efficient home in Utah, so it makes sense to ensure they are of the highest quality possible. Our triple-pane replacement windows offer many advantages over double-pane windows, such as: Less temperature bleed-through in extreme weather Better sound dampening Added security Indestructible Vinyl Vinyl windows have been around since the 1950s ( like us ) and have since become the most popular replacement window material in the United States. Vinyl windows easily shrug off the effects of extreme weather and stand up to the test of time. They don’t shrink, chip, flake, or buckle and will look the same whether it’s been 20 days or 20 years after they were installed. Best of all, they need almost zero maintenance. All you have to do is clean them regularly, and they will last you a lifetime. Triple-Pane = Triple-Protection Triple-pane replacement windows have all other windows beat hands down . More Efficient – Triple-pane windows are so efficient that they offer better R-value than some solid walls. That means your windows make it easier for your HVAC system to maintain your preferred indoor temperature. A Quieter Lifestyle – Triple-pane windows trap soundwaves more effectively than double-pane windows. This added protection leaves you free to enjoy the quiet of your home without the noise of the outside world disturbing your peace. Increased Security – Breaking through a glass window is a messy business. So, when your window has three panes to break through, it’s a good chance your average thief will move on rather than climb through or clear out three layers of shattered glass. Excuses for Delaying Your Wasatch Front Siding Project About Us Contact Galleries Financing Resources Phone (801) 997-6616 Get Pre-Approved Siding Rain Gutters Windows Decks Other Services Why Us At RGS Exteriors, We Know That Sometimes Your New Wasatch Front Siding Can’t Wait Here Are 3 TERRIBLE Excuses For Putting Off Your Siding Installation Project. Your siding is both a critical layer of protection for your Wasatch Front home and an aesthetic feature that gives it character. That’s a pretty big job for one material. That’s why it’s so important to replace your siding when the time comes with long-lasting, eco-friendly, and ever-durable James Hardie siding . It will provide fare MUCH better against the elements than vinyl or aluminum and will keep your home looking great for DECADES to come. That’s why you shouldn’t wait around and make excuses if your siding is due for replacement. #1: Waiting Until Next Year (Even Though It’s Already Deteriorating) With any home upgrade, there is always the temptation to put it off until next year…even though it probably needs to be replaced NOW. This isn’t something you should risk if you live in the Salt Lake City area. A full year of harsh winds, hail, thunderstorms, snow, and more can cause a LOT of damage to your home if it’s not properly shielded from the elements. You’re better off installing new siding now, so your home will be watertight and secure–whatever the weather brings. James Hardie fiber cement siding has a lifespan twice as long as other siding options, an excellent product warranty, and a level of durability that is virtually unmatched. That means you won’t have to replace your siding again for a VERY long time. #2: Don’t Want To Deal With The Hassle & Stress Having work done on your home brings a stress that no Wasatch Front homeowner loves. In fact, due to bad home contractor experiences, some homeowners avoid exterior remodeling work at all costs. While understandable, this is NOT a good idea if you have siding that needs to be replaced. Plus, if you choose RGS Exteriors for your siding installation, you can cut your stress and frustration down to zero. Our Process for exterior remodeling is so careful and precise, you will hardly notice our presence. As for our installers, they’re the most respectful, well-vetted professionals you’ll ever work with. #3: Don’t Want To Dip Into Savings To Pay For It Exterior remodeling projects can get expensive, and siding is no exception. A lot of homeowners in the Salt Lake City area will wait MUCH longer than they should to replace their damaged siding in the interest of preserving their savings. Not wanting to spend the money is reasonable, but with a flexible financing plan you can install your new siding now without having to pay a large sum all at once. In fact, you will likely be able to make monthly payments without having to dip into savings AT ALL. Plus, with our financing plans, you can pay zero interest for as long as 24 months, so you won’t have to spend an additional dime to receive financing. So–while there are plenty of things to avoid, putting off replacing your old siding is no longer something to excuse.
